scene_facts: The image shows a retail display of Chinese liquor boxes. A gloved hand is pointing at a peach-colored box labeled '海之蓝' (Hai Zhi Lan), which translates to 'Ocean Blue'. This is a well-known brand of Moutai liquor. The other visible brands include 'Red Star' (yellow boxes) and 'Dream Blue' (blue boxes). The pointing gesture clearly targets the 'Ocean Blue' box.
